scope: Seller commission and payment processing on US Whatnot sales under the tiered commission structure that took effect September 21, 2026. State sales tax on fees, the Premier Shop discount and promotional rates are described but not computed.
structure: Two fees are deducted per checkout transaction. Commission is a percentage of the item's sale price; shipping and taxes paid by the buyer are not included. Since September 21, 2026 the rate depends on two things: the category group of the sale, and the tier the seller unlocked with total sales across all categories in the previous four-week period. US tiers: Standard $0 – $14,999, Tier 1 $15,000 – $34,999, Tier 2 $35,000 – $49,999, Tier 3 $50,000 – $99,999, Tier 4 $100,000 – $249,999, Tier 5 $250,000 – $499,999, Tier 6 $500,000+. US rates from Standard to Tier 6: Sports and TCG 8% falling to 6.5%; Fashion 8% falling to 4.5%; Other Collectibles 8% falling to 5%; Coins 4% falling to 3.5%; Other 8% falling to 4%. A rate is locked for the whole four-week period: crossing into a higher tier lowers the rate for the next period, not the current one, and tiers reset every 28 days. Payment processing is 2.9% of the total order value paid by the buyer (item price, buyer-paid shipping and taxes) plus a fixed $0.30 per transaction, and is not reduced by the tier. In select categories the commission is 0% on the portion of an individual order's price above $1,500, a limited-time promotion, while processing still applies to the full amount. For live sales the rate follows the category of the show; for marketplace sales, the category of the product.
quotes: Our new commission rate structure took effect September 21, 2026 for existing sellers.
If you gained selling access after September 21, the new structure takes effect the week of September 28, 2026.
Your sales in a four-week period determine the tier you unlock and the rate you pay for the next period.
Your rate is locked for the full period. Crossing into a higher tier during a period lowers your rate for the next period, not right away.
Reduced rates apply to your Whatnot selling commission only. Payment processing and other seller fees still apply.
“Total sales” means the combined sale price of your completed orders across all categories.
Whatnot calculates commission on Gross Merchandise Value (GMV), which is the sale price of the item. Shipping and taxes paid by the buyer are not included.
You sell a $10 item with $4.99 shipping and $0.85 in sales tax.
Whatnot: An 8% commission on the $10 item price = $0.80
Payment processing fees are calculated on the total order value paid by the buyer, including the item price, buyer-paid shipping, and taxes, plus a fixed transaction fee.
US, Canada, Australia: 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction
What doesn't. Private shows, local pickup orders, and cancelled orders are subtracted from your total.
your Premier Shop discount applies on top of your new commission rate. For example, if your rate is 5%, the 10% Premier Shop discount brings it to 4.5%.
Premier Shop no longer includes a commission discount.
Rates as low as 3% are custom rates available to our highest-volume sellers who work directly with a dedicated account manager on custom terms.
For live sales: the rate is based on the category of the show. For marketplace (non-live) sales: the rate is based on the category of the product.
Products properly listed under the following categories qualify for a 4% commission fee: Coins & Bullion Paper Money & Currency
Standard payment processing fees and any applicable taxes on fees still apply.

Starting January 14, 2026, Whatnot began charging a 0% commission on the portion of the sale price over 1,500 (USD/AUD/EUR/GBP 1,500 or JPY 225,000) on individual orders in select categories plus standard payment processing.
Starting at 12:00am EST on June 4th, 2026, Whatnot extended this promotion to include individual orders in Bags & Accessories and Jewelry & Watches.
Rate only applies to the Singles subcategories in Sports Cards. Sports breaks and Surprise Products are excluded from the promotion.
You will be charged standard commission (for the US, 8%) on the first $1,500. Your total commission fee will be $120.

This is a limited-time promotion. Whatnot reserves the right to modify, suspend, or end this promotion, including the eligible categories, qualifying thresholds, and commission rates, at any time and for any reason, with or without prior notice.

State laws require Whatnot to collect sales tax on Whatnot Commissions and Fees in the following states: Commission: District of Columbia, Hawaii, New Mexico, West Virginia Payment Processing Fee: Connecticut (special 1% rate), Hawaii, New Mexico, Ohio, South Dakota, Texas (standard rate reduced by 20%), West Virginia Show Promotion and Boost: Hawaii, New Mexico, South Dakota
excluded: Other markets: Whatnot publishes separate tier tables for Canada, the United Kingdom, France, Belgium, Germany, Austria, the Netherlands and Australia, and flat rates for Japan; EU and UK rates are subject to VAT and their processing fee is 2.42% + €/£0.25
Premier Shop discount (10% off the commission rate through October 31, 2026; none from November 1, 2026)
Promotional rates (new-seller 0% fees, launch and limited-time category promotions) and custom rates for the highest-volume sellers
The flat rates that applied through September 27, 2026 to sellers who gained selling access after September 21, including the 4% Pallets rate
Show Promotion and Boost fees (amounts not on the loaded pages)
Shipping label costs and Early Payout terms
Buyer-side fees and buyer sales tax
notes: Re-read 2026-09-28. Whatnot replaced its flat commission table with tiered rates on September 21, 2026. At the Standard tier the rates are what they were: 8% in every group except Coins, 4%.
The fee page names six category groups (Sports, TCG, Fashion, Other Collectibles, Coins, Other) and does not list which product categories fall in each; a seller's own rate card is in Seller Hub.
Tier is set by total sales in all categories over the previous four-week period; private shows, local pickup orders and cancelled orders do not count.

High-value orders: the promotion's article is dated July 31, 2026, before the tiered structure, and its example uses the 8% standard rate on the first $1,500. How the promotion combines with a lower tier rate is not stated on the loaded pages; this calculator applies the selected tier's rate to the first $1,500. The promotion is limited-time and Whatnot may end it at any time. Eligible categories: Comics & Anime, Toys & Hobbies, Coins & Money, Trading Card Games, Entertainment Cards, Sports Singles subcategories, Bags & Accessories, Jewelry & Watches; sports breaks and Surprise Products are excluded.

Premier Shop: through October 31, 2026 the 10% Premier Shop discount applies on top of the tier rate (5% becomes 4.5%); from November 1, 2026 it no longer includes a commission discount. Not computed here.
Rates 'as low as 3%' are custom rates for the highest-volume sellers and are not on the public table.
The 'Sell More, Earn More' article, the earlier test of tiered rates, is no longer published (404 on 2026-09-28).
Payment processing uses the buyer's total including sales tax, so an exact fee needs shipping and buyer tax as inputs.

Taxes on fees: sellers in DC, HI, NM, WV pay state sales tax on the commission; sellers in CT (special 1% rate), HI, NM, OH, SD, TX (standard rate reduced by 20%) and WV pay it on the payment processing fee. Not computed.
summary: Whatnot takes a commission on the item's sale price, 8% in most categories and 4% on coins at the Standard tier, and less as a seller's four-week sales grow (down to 4% to 6.5%, or 3.5% on coins), plus 2.9% + 30¢ payment processing on the buyer's total including shipping and tax. The tiered rates took effect September 21, 2026.
